Subject: Athletic subscriptions 
 
All: How many of you guys have a subscription to The Athletic?
I’ve seen a few expenses for them, and I’m wondering if we just all need to use the FreepSports account there.
I totally agree we all need access to the site, but I think consolidating into one account may be more cost efficient.
